## Causes of the French Revolution

**Financial Crisis.** By the late 1780s, France was effectively bankrupt. Decades of costly wars—particularly the Seven Years' War and, most damagingly, the decision to fund the American Revolution—had swollen the national debt to roughly 2.3 billion livres.
